Off. Ads are not being blocked.
Off, because another VPN (like Surfshark) was turned on. Android only allows one VPN at a time. While Surfshark is on, turn on its CleanWeb feature to block ads.

Android only allows one VPN at a time, so turning on AdShield will disconnect your other VPN (like Surfshark).\n\nIf you want to stay on Surfshark, keep it and turn on CleanWeb in Surfshark\'s settings instead. It blocks ads and malware too.
AdShield needs the VPN permission to block ads. Nothing leaves your phone; it filters lookups locally.

• Using Surfshark or another VPN? Android only runs one VPN at a time. Use AdShield when your VPN is off, and turn on CleanWeb in Surfshark when it is on.

• To keep it running after restarts, open VPN settings, tap the gear next to AdShield and turn on "Always-on VPN".

• If ads still get through, check Settings › Network › Private DNS is "Off" or "Automatic". A custom Private DNS provider skips AdShield.

• In Chrome, turn off Settings › Privacy › "Use secure DNS" for the same reason.

• If a site or app breaks, find it under "Recently blocked" and add it to "Never block".
